title: 美股盘前：油价与长债回落推动科技反弹，HUM与NVDA领涨；电信、AAPL和DAL承压
summary: 截至20:28 CST，道指、标普500和纳指100期货约涨0.07%、0.35%和0.72%，10年期美债收益率回落至约5.24%，Brent降至约103.20美元。HUM因Medicare星级改善盘前涨14.2%，NVDA涨1.5%，TSLA涨1.1%；TMUS、T、VZ、AAPL和DAL遭明确负反馈。今晚无可验证的大型科技公司盘后财报样本。

开盘反馈
港股科技修复延续，A股成长跌幅扩大

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
09:50 CST可得盘后代理：QQQ +0.29%、SPY +0.22%、DIA +0.22%；均为延迟ETF代理，不冒充指数期货。
板块对照
医药强势与盘后代理同向但幅度有限，属于确认；芯片隔夜重挫后仅见大盘代理小幅反弹，属于背离而非反转；排行快照早于最新现金时段，当前板块逐项夜盘报价不可得。
A/H映射
港股科技修复延续，但A股成长跌幅扩大形成明显背离；恒科回落至平盘或创业板继续下探将削弱修复判断。

盘前结论

港股科技修复延续，但A股成长跌幅扩大；奕斯伟首挂跌破发行区间转为回避

恒指与恒科10:04分别涨1.00%和1.50%，港股科技修复延续。沪指跌0.71%、创业板跌2.09%，A股成长压力较09:44进一步扩大。奕斯伟1.45港元低于1.55港元发行价与1.48港元区间下限，负面反馈不能包装为多头。

重点个股关注

建研院
A.603183
条件关注
事件：瀚启投资拟以5.03元/股收购9.90%，10月9日复牌；后续仍需协议转让、治理安排与审批配合。
最新反馈：09:36报5.19元，盘中高5.22、低4.76，成交2165万股；高于5.03元要约锚但波动剧烈。
确认/失效：若后续稳定在5.03元上方且成交承接持续，可继续观察；跌回要约价下方、冲高回落或控制权安排失败则失效。
奕斯伟计算
H.01256
回避
事件：RISC-V芯片公司今日首挂，发行价1.55港元；招股书与上市安排已核验。
最新反馈：10:04报1.45港元、成交约1.21亿股，已跌破1.55港元发行价和1.48港元招股区间下限。
回避依据：正式交易已触发原失效条件；除非重新站回1.55港元并出现持续成交承接，否则不升级为条件关注或多头候选。
迅销
H.06288
条件关注
事件：FY2026经营利润同比增32%至7431.3亿日元，连续第五年创纪录，并指引下一财年继续增长。
最新反馈：香港预托证券10月8日停牌；公司行情页最近可核验为10月5日36.40港元，复牌前无同步报价。
确认/失效：仅在复牌后价格守住最近参考位且量价确认时升级；若业绩利好兑现后跌破36.40或中国业务指引恶化则失效。
李子园
A.605337
回避
事件：独立董事兼审计委员会主任委员接受纪律审查，公司称案件与经营无关并将补选。
基本面反证：2026年上半年营收同比降2.69%、归母净利降32.34%，经营现金流净额同比降82.84%。
回避依据：提交前未取得可靠同步报价；治理空缺与盈利下滑尚未出现可核验反转，不因调查“与公司无关”的声明包装为多头。

板块轮动看板

汇率与高股息央行稳汇率表态有利于降低外资风险溢价，但长债和油价高位仍压制估值扩张。
半导体/RISC-V恒科+1.50%提供修复，但创业板-2.09%且奕斯伟跌破发行区间，芯片与成长分化扩大。
能源与炼化Brent 104.28美元、单日+4.1%，上游受益而航空、化工下游和消费物流成本承压。
医药康复残疾预防计划与隔夜医药相对强势形成政策+外盘映射，仍需A股开盘广度确认。

逻辑链

央行稳汇率表态 → 贬值预期尾部风险下降 → 高股息与外资偏好资产先受益，但不抵消高利率压力。
Brent +4.1%至104.28美元 → 输入性通胀与成本压力升高 → 上游能源强、航空化工下游弱的分化扩大。
SOX -3.4%且纳指-1.25% → A/H高估值芯片承压 → 奕斯伟首挂跌破发行区间，转为回避而非题材买点。
要约与强业绩公告 → 建研院、迅销出现独立事件催化 → 必须等待复牌价格与成交确认，避免利好兑现。

风险雷达

隔夜科技纳指跌1.25%、SOX跌3.4%，A/H芯片若高开缺乏成交承接，反身性回撤风险高。
油债组合Brent 104.28美元、10年美债约5.23%，同时抬高成本与贴现率。
事件溢价建研院与迅销复牌仍有一次性计价风险；奕斯伟已跌破发行区间，负面价格确认优先于题材叙事。
数据时效AKShare为10月8日盘中而非收盘；美股排行快照早于10月8日现金时段，按规则降级为0行。

数据来源与时间点

首轮截止2026-10-09 08:39 CST；首轮增量抓取约09:44—09:58，二次复核至10:04，共补入A股跌幅扩大与奕斯伟正式首挂反馈。盘中行情：Google Finance与信报港股360；美股夜盘为Investing.com延迟ETF代理。AKShare仍为2026-10-08盘中基线，未冒充当日行情；美股排行快照早于最新现金时段，继续降级为0行。公告与政策事实沿用已核验原始来源。

Opening feedback
Hong Kong tech keeps rebounding as A-share growth losses widen
At 10:04 CST, HSI rose 1.00% and HSTECH 1.50%, while the Shanghai Composite fell 0.71%, Shenzhen Component 1.62% and ChiNext 2.09%. ESWIN traded at HK$1.45, below the HK$1.55 issue price and HK$1.48 offer-range floor.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight indices
Delayed after-hours ETF proxies available at 09:50 CST: QQQ +0.29%, SPY +0.22% and DIA +0.22%; these are proxies, not index futures.
Sector cross-check
Healthcare strength aligns with the modest ETF rebound and is a confirmation. Chips only saw a broad proxy bounce after the cash-session selloff, a divergence rather than a reversal. The ranking snapshot predates the latest cash session, and row-level overnight quotes are unavailable.
A/H mapping
Hong Kong tech's rebound persists, but widening A-share growth losses create a clear divergence; a return of HSTECH to flat or further ChiNext downside would weaken the repair signal.

Pre-market Conclusion

Hong Kong tech repair persists, but A-share growth losses widen; ESWIN breaks below its offer range and moves to avoid

HSI and HSTECH rose 1.00% and 1.50% at 10:04 CST, extending the Hong Kong tech repair.The Shanghai Composite fell 0.71% and ChiNext 2.09%, deepening A-share growth pressure from the earlier check.ESWIN at HK$1.45 is below both the HK$1.55 issue price and HK$1.48 offer-range floor, so negative feedback is not repackaged as bullish.

Stock Focus

Suzhou Institute of Building Science
A.603183
Conditional watch
Event: Jiangsu Hanqi proposes a 9.90% tender at CNY5.03 and trading resumed Oct 9; later transfers, governance changes and approvals are still required.
Latest feedback: at 09:36 it traded at CNY5.19 after ranging from CNY4.76 to CNY5.22 on 21.65 million shares; it is above the CNY5.03 anchor but highly volatile.
Confirmation/invalidation: continued trading above CNY5.03 with sustained volume support keeps the watch valid; a drop below the tender anchor, spike-and-fade or failed control arrangements invalidate it.
ESWIN Computing
H.01256
Avoid
Event: the RISC-V chip designer debuted today at a HK$1.55 issue price; the prospectus and listing schedule are verified.
Latest feedback: it traded at HK$1.45 by 10:04 CST on about 121 million shares, below both the issue price and the HK$1.48 offer-range floor.
Avoid rationale: formal trading triggered the prior invalidation condition; do not upgrade unless it reclaims HK$1.55 with sustained volume support.
Fast Retailing
H.06288
Conditional watch
Event: FY2026 operating profit rose 32% to JPY743.13bn, a fifth straight record, with further growth guided.
Latest feedback: the Hong Kong DR was halted Oct 8; the company quote page’s latest verifiable price is HK$36.40 on Oct 5, so no synchronized resumption quote exists yet.
Confirm/invalidate: upgrade only if the resumed price holds the latest reference with volume; a post-results break below HK$36.40 or weaker China guidance invalidates.
Liziyuan
A.605337
Avoid
Event: an independent director and audit-committee chair is under investigation; the company says the case is unrelated to operations and will appoint a replacement.
Fundamental counter-evidence: 1H revenue fell 2.69%, attributable profit 32.34%, and operating cash flow 82.84% year on year.
Avoid rationale: no reliable synchronized quote was obtained before submission; the governance vacancy and earnings decline lack a verified reversal and are not repackaged as bullish.

Sector Rotation

FX and dividendsPBOC currency guidance reduces foreign-risk premium, but high long yields and oil still cap multiple expansion.
Semis / RISC-VHSTECH +1.50% offers a repair signal, but ChiNext -2.09% and ESWIN's offer-range break widen the chip/growth divergence.
Energy and refiningBrent at $104.28, up 4.1%, favors upstream exposure while airlines, chemicals and logistics face cost pressure.
Healthcare and rehabThe disability-prevention plan plus US healthcare resilience create a policy/overnight mapping; A-share opening breadth must confirm.

Logic Chain

PBOC FX guidance → lower devaluation-tail risk → dividend and foreign-preference assets benefit first, without cancelling the high-rate drag.
Brent +4.1% to $104.28 → higher imported inflation and costs → wider divergence between upstream energy and airlines/chemical users.
SOX -3.4% and Nasdaq -1.25% → pressure on high-valuation A/H chips → ESWIN breaks below its offer range and moves to avoid, not an automatic theme buy.
Tender and earnings events → independent catalysts for Suzhou Institute and Fast Retailing → resumption price and volume must confirm.

Risk Radar

Overnight techNasdaq -1.25% and SOX -3.4%; A/H chips that gap up without volume support face reflexive drawdown risk.
Oil and yieldsBrent at $104.28 and the US 10-year near 5.23% lift both costs and discount rates.
Event premiumsSuzhou Institute and Fast Retailing still face one-off repricing risk; ESWIN’s offer-range break makes negative price confirmation more important than the theme narrative.
Data freshnessAKShare is an Oct 8 intraday snapshot, not the close; US rankings predate the Oct 8 cash session and are degraded to zero rows.

Sources and Timestamps

First-run cutoff: 2026-10-09 08:39 CST. The first incremental check covered 09:44-09:58, and a second review through 10:04 added wider A-share losses and ESWIN's formal-debut feedback. Intraday quotes: Google Finance and HKEJ Stock360. US overnight data are delayed ETF proxies from Investing.com. AKShare remains an Oct 8 intraday baseline and is not presented as today's market; the US ranking snapshot predates the latest cash session and remains degraded to zero rows. Policy and announcement facts retain verified primary sources.

entries.title: 美股盘前：油价与长债回落推动科技反弹，HUM与NVDA领涨；电信、AAPL和DAL承压
entries.title_en: US premarket: Lower oil and yields lift technology; HUM and NVDA lead while telecom, AAPL and DAL fall
entries.summary: 截至20:28 CST，道指、标普500和纳指100期货约涨0.07%、0.35%和0.72%，10年期美债收益率回落至约5.24%，Brent降至约103.20美元。HUM因Medicare星级改善盘前涨14.2%，NVDA涨1.5%，TSLA涨1.1%；TMUS、T、VZ、AAPL和DAL遭明确负反馈。今晚无可验证的大型科技公司盘后财报样本。
entries.summary_en: As of 20:28 CST, Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures were up about 0.07%, 0.35% and 0.72%; the US 10-year yield eased to about 5.24% and Brent fell to roughly $103.20. HUM rose 14.2% after better Medicare ratings, NVDA gained 1.5% and TSLA rose 1.1%. TMUS, T, VZ, AAPL and DAL received clear negative price feedback. No verifiable large technology company was found on tonight's after-close earnings calendar.

SPCX涨3.9%，但TMUS跌7.3%、T跌5.8%、VZ跌5.4%；市场直接计入低轨卫星进入传统移动通信的竞争压力。
医疗
HUM获Medicare星级正反馈
美国政府数据显示Humana约95%的Medicare Advantage会员进入2027年四星或以上计划；HUM盘前涨14.2%，08:19 ET报价约442.53美元、涨14.31%。
消费电子
AAPL减产报道触发负反馈
AAPL盘前跌1.8%；报道指部分iPhone 18 Pro和Pro Max零部件订单被削减，内存成本与提价压制需求。
航空
DAL下调利润展望后下跌
Delta第三季盈利不及预期，并将全年利润预测区间中值下调近四分之一；盘前跌4.5%，油价回落尚未扭转公司级负反馈。
盈利
AI贡献第三季盈利大部分增量
LSEG预计标普500第三季盈利同比增长约31%，其中约三分之二增量来自科技和GOOGL、AMZN、META等AI龙头。
日程
银行财报与消费者信心接棒
JPM与GS等大型银行下周开启财报季；今日10:00 ET密歇根大学消费者信心初值将检验高成本与就业放缓影响。

盘前结论

事实：油价和长债从高位回落，三大期指转涨，纳指100期货和芯片领跑；HUM获得最强公司级正反馈。

判断：开盘基线从防守转为选择性反弹。优先跟踪HUM、NVDA和TSLA的相对强度，避免抄底电信、AAPL和DAL等已出现明确负反馈的标的。

不确定性：Brent仍高于100美元、10年期仍处多年高位，且AI盈利增速门槛很高；消费者信心与开盘量价可能迅速改变反弹质量。

重点个股推荐

HumanaHUM
评级正反馈

推荐理由：Medicare Advantage星级改善直接关系未来奖励支付；Reuters显示盘前涨14.2%，08:19 ET可得报价约442.53美元、涨14.31%，显著跑赢大盘。

触发因素：开盘守住430美元并维持相对医疗保险板块强势，跳空不被快速回补。

风险点：涨幅已大且接近52周高位；本轮未取得可靠带时标盘前成交量，不表述为放量，政策与利用率风险仍高。

NvidiaNVDA
AI反弹领涨

推荐理由：周四AI抛售后盘前涨1.5%，同时SOXX涨1.4%，价格反馈确认芯片反弹而非单一新闻叙事。

触发因素：开盘继续跑赢SOXX与QQQ，并守住盘前涨幅的大部分。

风险点：OpenAI收入低于此前信号、AI资本开支回报率和5.24%长债仍是估值压力；可靠带时标盘前成交量未取得。

TeslaTSLA
相对强势

推荐理由：盘前约379美元、涨约1.1%，明显跑赢道指和标普期货；Terafab芯片项目治理叙事与分析师积极评级提供边际催化。

触发因素：开盘守住375美元并持续跑赢纳指100，同时成交承接改善。

风险点：高估值、汽车需求和项目执行仍敏感；本轮未取得可靠带时标盘前成交量，不将上涨写成放量突破。

板块轮动看板

强势观察

AI芯片与大型成长反弹，HUM提供独立医疗催化；NVDA、TSLA需开盘后继续跑赢基准。

事件驱动

HUM的Medicare星级、SpaceX频谱交易和10:00 ET消费者信心是主要个股/宏观催化。

压力方向

传统电信、AAPL与DAL均有明确负反馈；不因指数反弹而抄底。

验证信号

Brent能否维持103美元附近、10年期能否留在5.25%下方、SOXX与三只强势股能否守住盘前涨幅。

逻辑链

新闻事实

中东供应担忧缓和令油价回落，长债从极端高位降温；AI盈利预期仍强但门槛上升。

资产反馈

纳指100期货领涨、SOXX和NVDA反弹；电信、AAPL与DAL因公司/行业利空下跌。

板块传导

资金回流AI与高质量成长，同时惩罚面临新竞争、需求削弱或指引下调的公司。

开盘判断

油债稳定时科技可延续选择性反弹；若10年期重新上冲或Brent反弹，指数涨幅与高估值个股承接将受压。

盘后财报 beat 概率

可验证盘后科技财报公司不足/无大型科技公司：Earnings Whispers的10月9日日历列出6家公司且全部盘前、盘后为0；Digrin仅列瑞典房地产公司Atrium Ljungberg盘后，Tickzen列出的CLSD属于医疗而非科技。因缺少符合条件的具体科技样本，不虚构公司、一致预期、历史surprise或beat概率。

风险雷达

油价仍在高位

Brent虽回落至约103.20美元，但仍高于100美元；中东消息反复可迅速重启通胀交易。

长债压力未解

10年期回落至5.24%但仍接近24年高位，高估值科技对再上行极其敏感。

AI盈利高门槛

标普第三季盈利预期增长31%，约三分之二增量来自科技与AI龙头，任何指引不及预期都可能放大回撤。

电信竞争重估

SpaceX频谱交易使TMUS、T和VZ跌5.4%至7.3%，价格反馈说明竞争风险不是抽象叙事。

事件股跳空回落

HUM涨幅超过14%；若开盘成交承接不足，获利回吐可能快速扩大。

数据来源与时间点

来源与时点：Reuters截至美东07:05的期指、10年债、油价、NVDA/TSLA/SPCX、电信、HUM、AAPL与DAL反馈；WSJ核验Brent、WTI、黄金、比特币与AI反弹；MEXC核验HUM 08:19 ET报价；Barron's核验TSLA盘前价与Terafab催化；Reuters/LSEG核验第三季盈利预期；Earnings Whispers、Digrin与Tickzen核验盘后财报日历。内容于2026-10-09 20:28 CST（08:28 ET）复核；HUM、NVDA、TSLA可靠带时标盘前量能不足，均已明确降级。

Major News
Market
Lower oil lifts index futures
Reuters showed Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures up 0.07%, 0.35% and 0.72% at 07:05 ET, with technology futures leading.
Energy
Middle East supply fear eases at the margin
The US said it would not strike Iran before the midterm elections. Brent fell more than 1% but stayed above $100; WSJ showed Brent near $103.20 and WTI near $90.64.
Rates
The 10-year yield eases to 5.24%
The US 10-year Treasury yield was about 5.24%, below Wednesday's 24-year high of 5.364%; valuation pressure eased but did not disappear.
Chips
AI and semiconductors rebound from Thursday's selloff
NVDA rose 1.5% premarket and SOXX gained 1.4%, with AMD, INTC and MRVL also broadly higher. The rebound still needs opening-volume confirmation.
Competition
SpaceX spectrum deal hits legacy telecom
SPCX rose 3.9%, but TMUS fell 7.3%, T lost 5.8% and VZ eased 5.4% as markets priced a direct orbital challenge to conventional mobile carriers.
Healthcare
HUM rallies on improved Medicare ratings
US government data showed about 95% of Humana Medicare Advantage members in four-star or higher plans for 2027. HUM rose 14.2%; an available 08:19 ET quote was about $442.53, up 14.31%.
Devices
AAPL gets negative feedback on production cuts
AAPL fell 1.8% premarket after a report that some iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max component orders were reduced as memory costs and higher prices weighed on demand.
Airlines
DAL falls after lowering its profit outlook
Delta missed third-quarter earnings expectations and cut the midpoint of its full-year profit range by nearly one-quarter. Shares fell 4.5%, and lower oil did not reverse the company-specific penalty.
Earnings
AI supplies most of the expected earnings gain
LSEG expects S&P 500 third-quarter earnings to rise about 31% year over year, with roughly two-thirds of the increase from technology and AI leaders such as GOOGL, AMZN and META.
Calendar
Banks and consumer sentiment come next
Major banks including JPM and GS begin reporting next week. Today's 10:00 ET preliminary University of Michigan consumer sentiment reading will test the impact of high costs and a slower labor market.

Premarket View

Fact:Oil and long yields eased from their highs, all three futures rose, Nasdaq 100 futures and chips led, and HUM had the strongest company-specific price reaction.

View:The opening setup shifts from defense to a selective rebound. HUM, NVDA and TSLA are preferred relative-strength watches; telecom, AAPL and DAL are not dip buys after clear negative feedback.

Uncertainty:Brent remains above $100, the 10-year yield remains near multiyear highs and the AI earnings hurdle is elevated. Consumer sentiment and opening volume can quickly change the quality of the rebound.

Stock Picks

HumanaHUM
Ratings catalyst

Why: Better Medicare Advantage star ratings directly affect future bonus payments. Reuters showed HUM up 14.2%, while an available 08:19 ET quote was about $442.53, up 14.31%, far ahead of the market.

Trigger: Hold above $430 after the open, maintain relative strength versus managed-care peers and avoid filling the gap quickly.

Risk: The gain is already large and near a 52-week high. Reliable timestamped premarket volume was unavailable, so this is not described as a volume breakout; policy and utilization risks remain high.

NvidiaNVDA
AI rebound leader

Why: NVDA rose 1.5% premarket after Thursday's AI selloff while SOXX gained 1.4%, giving the chip rebound direct price confirmation rather than a headline-only narrative.

Trigger: Continue to outperform SOXX and QQQ after the open and retain most of the premarket gain.

Risk: OpenAI revenue below its earlier signal, AI capex returns and a 5.24% long yield remain valuation risks. Reliable timestamped premarket volume was unavailable.

TeslaTSLA
Relative strength

Why: TSLA was near $379, up about 1.1% premarket, clearly outperforming Dow and S&P futures. Governance around the Terafab chip project and positive analyst commentary added a marginal catalyst.

Trigger: Hold $375 after the open, continue to outperform Nasdaq 100 and gain visible volume support.

Risk: Valuation, vehicle demand and project execution remain sensitive. Reliable timestamped premarket volume was unavailable, so the move is not labeled a volume breakout.

Sector Rotation

Relative strength

AI chips and large growth rebound, while HUM has an independent healthcare catalyst. NVDA and TSLA still need post-open benchmark outperformance.

Event-driven

Humana's Medicare ratings, SpaceX's spectrum deal and the 10:00 ET consumer sentiment reading are the main company and macro catalysts.

Pressure

Legacy telecom, AAPL and DAL all have explicit negative feedback and are not automatic dip buys during an index rebound.

Validation

Watch whether Brent holds near $103, the 10-year stays below 5.25%, and SOXX plus all three strong names retain their premarket gains.

Logic Chain

News facts

Easing Middle East supply fear lowers oil and long yields cool from extremes, while AI earnings expectations remain strong but increasingly demanding.

Asset reaction

Nasdaq 100 futures lead, SOXX and NVDA rebound, while telecom, AAPL and DAL fall on sector or company-specific negatives.

Sector transmission

Money returns to AI and quality growth but punishes businesses facing new competition, weaker demand or lower guidance.

Opening view

Technology can extend a selective rebound if oil and yields stabilize. A renewed rise in the 10-year or Brent would pressure index gains and expensive-growth follow-through.

After-Close Earnings Beat Probability

Insufficient verifiable after-close technology earnings candidates/no large technology companies: Earnings Whispers lists six companies on October 9 and all report before the open, with zero after the close. Digrin lists only Swedish property company Atrium Ljungberg after the close, while Tickzen's CLSD is healthcare rather than technology. With no qualifying named technology sample, no company, consensus estimate, historical surprise or beat probability is invented.

Risk Radar

Oil remains elevated

Brent eased to about $103.20 but remains above $100; renewed Middle East headlines could quickly restart the inflation trade.

Long-yield pressure persists

The 10-year eased to 5.24% but remains near a 24-year high, leaving expensive technology highly sensitive to another rise.

High AI earnings hurdle

S&P 500 third-quarter earnings are expected to grow 31%, with about two-thirds of the increase from technology and AI leaders; any weak guidance could magnify drawdowns.

Telecom competition repricing

SpaceX's spectrum deal sent TMUS, T and VZ down 5.4%-7.3%, showing that competitive risk is already producing direct price damage.

Event-stock gap fade

HUM is up more than 14%; weak opening follow-through could trigger rapid profit-taking.

Sources and Timing
